verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents that unresolved conversations pass to a human agent inside the same platform, and that escalations carry the full interaction history so the team picks up mid-conversation. That covers the 'full conversation' and 'no repeating' parts of the story, but only through vendor claims, one of them on an industry-specific page. Missing for 10: any evidence of an auto-generated escalation summary, structured handoff of collected customer details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the handoff experience.
